title: Linear functionals and adjoint operators on inner product spaces
objectives: Represent linear functionals by vectors and find the vector
Construct the adjoint and compute its matrix in any basis
Prove the algebraic rules of adjoints and decompose operators
Recognize the failure of both existence theorems in infinite dimension
prerequisites: Inner products and orthonormal bases (Chapters 21 and 22); dual spaces and transposes (Chapter 11).
source_scope: The captions of the four recordings (positions 48 to 51) were read in full. The evaluation example, the projection onto a line, the matrix, trace, multiplication and differentiation examples come from them; the derivative adjoint on quadratics, the general-basis formula, the transpose relation, the range-kernel facts, laboratory and exercises are original.
